name: nginx-multisite
description: Nginx web server provisioning with multi-site virtual host management, self-signed SSL certificate generation per vhost, HTTP-to-HTTPS redirect enforcement, hardened security headers, rate limiting zones, and per-site static HTML content deployment for three subdomains.

name: cache
description: Dual caching layer provisioning for Memcached and Redis, including password authentication, custom log directory, and a post-install configuration fixup that strips deprecated Redis replica directives from the generated config file.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Full-stack Python FastAPI application deployment that installs system packages, clones the application from GitHub, creates a Python virtual environment, provisions a PostgreSQL database, writes a .env configuration file, and creates and enables a systemd service running uvicorn on port 8000.
